users.title: Employees
users.sub: Invite people, assign teams and set their contracts and work schedules.
users.employment_start_help: Target hours and vacation are counted from this day.
users.opening_balance_help: Carry-over from a previous system, e.g. 12:30 or -4:00.
users.self_role_help: You can't remove your own administrator role if you're the last administrator.
users.deactivate_message: {name} is signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. A running clock is stopped and API tokens are revoked. All data is kept and the account can be reactivated at any time.
users.set_password_help: The person is signed out on all devices and pending invitation or reset links stop working. Pass the password on personally (never by email); they can change it in their profile afterwards. The action is logged.
users.notify_password: Inform the person by email (the password itself is never sent)
users.admin_password_help: Confirms that you, and not someone using your open session, are setting this password.
users.role_help: Administrators manage users, teams, roles and settings – they do not see time data unless they also hold HR. Team leads are assigned on the Teams page.
users.employment_end_help: Last working day. Target hours and vacation stop after this date and the clock can no longer be used. The account stays active until you deactivate it.
users.vacation_days_help: Full-time days per year. Depending on Settings → Working time they are either taken as the person's own days or scaled by their scheduled days per week.
users.deactivate_lead_warning: {name} leads a team. That team will have no lead afterwards; vacation requests then go to the administrators.
users.reset_mfa_message: Use this when the person lost their phone and recovery codes. They sign in with their password only until they enable it again. The action is logged.
users.anonymize_message: Name and email are replaced by a placeholder, documents are deleted, sign-in logs, sessions and tokens are removed, and the name is scrubbed from the change history. Working-time records are kept for the statutory retention period. This cannot be undone.
users.capabilities_help: Administrators manage users, teams and settings but see no time data. Grant HR to the people who do. Team leadership is assigned on the Teams page.
users.cap_hr_long: HR: sees and signs off everyone's time, reports for all, reopens months, exports personal data
users.cap_projects_long: Projects: creates and maintains all projects, including company-wide ones

schedule.title: Weekly work schedule
schedule.help: Each version applies from its start date until the next version. Changing a contract adds a new version, so past months stay correct.
schedule.valid_from_help: Usually the first day of a month.
schedule.delete_message: The version valid from {date} will be removed. Target hours are recalculated.

vacation.override_help: Overrides the yearly default for this year only (e.g. seniority, part-year contract). The year of joining is pro-rated automatically.

teams.title: Teams
teams.sub: Group employees and name one or more leads and deputies who approve vacations, see the team's times and sign off months.
teams.empty_help: Create a team to name leads and deputies.
teams.no_lead_option: No lead yet – requests go to HR (or to administrators if there is no HR person).
teams.no_lead_help: Without a lead, requests are approved by HR (or by administrators if no HR person exists).
teams.lead_help: Several leads are possible. A deputy has the same powers as a lead while the period is current. Leads can name deputies for their own team themselves (Team overview).
teams.members_help: Each employee belongs to exactly one team; selecting someone moves them here.
teams.delete_message: Members keep all their data and become team-less.
teams.period_help: Leave the dates empty for an open-ended assignment; a deputy for a vacation gets the vacation dates.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.sub: Holiday calendars reduce target hours on working days. Assign them to the company, teams or single employees.
holidays.resolution_help: Which calendar applies: employee override → team calendar → company default.
holidays.now_default: This calendar is now the company default.
holidays.import_help: Adds the official holidays of a country or canton/state for one year. Existing dates are skipped, so you can safely import again.
holidays.include_half_days: Add 24 and 31 December as afternoon half-days
holidays.replace_year: Replace all holidays of that year
holidays.preset_help: Ready-made calendars maintained by RESORIX AG. Installing again only adds missing dates.
holidays.half_day_help: Half-day holidays always cover the afternoon (e.g. Christmas Eve).
holidays.none_help: Import the statutory holidays or add them manually.
holidays.delete_calendar_message: Used by {teams} teams and {users} people. They will fall back to the next calendar (team or company default).
holidays.replace_message: Existing holidays of that year in this calendar are deleted first, including ones you added by hand. Target hours of affected employees are recalculated.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Company-wide rules for time accounts, absences and security.
settings.defaults_help: Each person can change language and timezone in their profile.
settings.sessions_help: How long “Keep me signed in” lasts (every visit extends it, up to 90 days) and how long the sign-in log is kept.
settings.permissions_help: Team leads can always correct entries and approve absences of their members.
settings.lead_can_edit_schedules: Team leads may change work schedules
settings.lead_can_adjust_balances: Team leads may adjust balances and vacation entitlements
settings.holiday_mode_help: How holidays reduce the target hours, especially for part-time staff.
settings.mode_scheduled_help: A holiday only reduces the target if it falls on the person's working day. Simple and transparent.
settings.mode_prorata_help: Every Mon–Fri holiday credits employment level × full-time daily hours, even on a part-timer's day off.
settings.fulltime_weekly_help: Used for pro-rata holidays and as default schedule (e.g. 42:00).
settings.surcharge: Bonus for work on public holidays (%)
settings.surcharge_help: 0 = hours count normally; 25 = one hour worked counts as 1:15.
settings.law_help: Swiss ArG/ArGV 1 defaults. These rules create warnings, never blocks.
settings.break_rules: Warn about too short breaks (>5.5 h: 15 min, >7 h: 30 min, >9 h: 60 min)
settings.weekly_max_help: 45:00 for office and technical staff, 50:00 for others.
settings.edits_help: Every change is logged. A reason makes corrections traceable.
settings.reason_required: Employees must give a reason when editing past days
settings.clock_reminder_help: Email reminder if someone forgot to clock out. 0 = off.
settings.sick_help: Employees can report sick themselves on working days that are not holidays or vacation.
settings.login_log_retention_help: Security log of sign-in attempts, 30–3650 days.
settings.default_vacation_days: Vacation days per year for new employees
settings.rules_warning: Changing these rules recalculates target hours for all months, including months that are already signed off. The signed PDF statements and seals keep the figures that were valid at the time of sign-off.
settings.mfa_help: Everyone can enable it under Profile & security. Require it for administrators or for everyone: those people see a reminder on every sign-in until it is on.
settings.api_tokens_help: Personal access tokens let desktop apps and scripts use the API with limited permissions and an expiry date. Usage is logged per token.
settings.vacation_prorate: Pro-rate vacation days by scheduled days per week
settings.vacation_prorate_help: On: the yearly entitlement is a full-time value and is scaled by the person's scheduled days per week (25 days → 15 for a Mon–Wed schedule). Off: the entitlement is entered per person as their own days. Changing this recalculates all vacation accounts.
settings.worklog_help: Whether people describe what they did while clocked in – as free text, by project, or both. Projects are managed under Team → Projects.
settings.worklog_percent: Required share of the worked time (%)
settings.worklog_percent_help: Each day's described time must reach this share of its worked time; days below it warn the person and block the month sign-off.
settings.worklog_project_required: Every item needs a project (free text stays available in addition)

types.title: Absence types
types.sub: Control what employees can request and how each type affects time and vacation accounts.
types.requires_approval_long: Requests must be approved by the team lead
types.employee_can_request_long: Employees can request / report it themselves
types.allows_attachments_long: Documents can be attached (e.g. doctor's note)
types.credits_time_long: Reduces the target hours (no minus hours for these days)
types.legend: Sickness types follow the self-report rules (working days only, limited backdating). Types without “credits time” use up the time balance (e.g. time off in lieu).
types.label: Label
types.label_help: Built-in types are shown translated in the app; this label is used for custom types and in exports.
types.key_help: Stable identifier, lowercase (e.g. moving_day). Can't be changed later.
types.flag_warning: Changing this flag recalculates past months, including signed-off ones. Continue?

email.title: Email (SMTP)
email.sub: Used for invitations, password resets and notifications.
email.env_help: SMTP is configured through environment variables (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_SECURITY, MAIL_FROM) in the .env file – see README.

backups.title: Database backups
backups.sub: Backups of the database and documents, the complete change log and all sign-in attempts.
backups.help: Consistent online backups: a ZIP with the database and documents, encrypted with the server's backup password. One is created automatically every night at 02:00.
backups.restore_help: For safety, restoring is done on the server while the app is stopped; the container decrypts with its backup password. The current database is kept as a copy.
backups.encrypted_note: Every backup – nightly, manual or downloaded – is encrypted (Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305) with the BACKUP_PASSWORD from the server configuration. Keep that password in your password manager: without it a backup cannot be opened or restored.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: Every change to time entries, absences, balances, schedules and users – who, when, what and why.

logins.title: Sign-in log
logins.sub: All sign-in attempts, successful and failed – for security monitoring.
logins.retention_help: Entries are deleted automatically after the retention period configured in Settings → General.

reasons.token_issued: Signed in from an app (token issued)

branding.title: Company and colours
branding.sub: Shown on the sign-in page, in the app, in emails and on PDF reports.
branding.company_help: Appears in emails, reports and the browser title.
branding.accent_help: Used for buttons, links and highlights. Leave empty to keep the default.
branding.logo_help: SVG or PNG, up to 512 KB, with a transparent background and at least 64 px tall. Upload a PNG if the logo should also appear in emails.
branding.removed: Logo removed. The default logo is used again.
branding.remove_message: The built-in default logo will be shown instead.

tokens.title: Personal API tokens
tokens.sub: Every token used by desktop apps and scripts: who owns it, what it may do, when it expires, when and from where it was last used. Creation, use and revocation are logged.
tokens.revoke_message: The token stops working immediately. The owner is notified and the revocation is logged with your name and reason.
